## SEO Agent — Rank Tracker
Runs **weekly (Monday 08:00)** and on demand through *Manual Run* (Execute Workflow Trigger). Reads every ladder from the Data Table `seo_ladders` (written by the ladder mode of SEO Agent v4; both tables are created on first use), checks the Google top 50 for each page's primary keyword and the head term (DataForSEO SERP live, about $0.015 per keyword; a 9-page ladder costs about $0.60 per month), appends `seo_rank_history`, and sends one progress e-mail / callback per ladder: positions vs the previous check, rungs in the top 10 / top 3, drops of 5+ positions, and the **recommended next rung** with a form link and a ready-to-send API body (recommend-only mode).
Guardrails: at most 15 keywords per ladder and 120 checks per run; once its top page has held the top 3 for 4 consecutive checks (failed checks skipped) a ladder is **won** and checked **monthly** (main keyword + published pages, v4.8) so a drop is noticed; a drop below the top 3 brings it back to weekly checks.
v4.8: the callback carries display-only flags per ladder for the web app (the e-mail is unchanged): `won` (main keyword in the top 3 in each of the last 4 checks, this one included) and `stuck` (pages published, the first 8+ weeks ago — dates from `seo_content_log` — and none improved its position over the last 8 weeks).
**v4.16 (G6, 2026-10-12 system review): the whole results page, from the same call.** Every check now stores what the page showed — AI Overview (shown, and whether it cites us), featured snippet, People Also Ask, local pack, video, shopping —, the **top-10 domains with their positions**, the **tracked competitors' positions** (`seo_monitors` + the `seo_sites` model column, merged by the one site model), a **share of voice** modelled on a published CTR curve, and a compact **snapshot of the top 10** (URLs + trimmed titles) as proof of the reading (`v5/code/_rank_serp.js`; columns `device` / `features_json` / `competitors_json` / `snapshot_json` / `share_of_voice`). All of it is free: it comes out of the SERP answer the check already pays for.
The only new spend is the **mobile check** of the ladder's main keywords (top rung + main page, at most 2 a ladder, once a week; a run started by hand inside 6 days reuses the last one): one more depth-50 call each, the measured **$0.015**, so about **$0.13 a month** for a ladder next to the ~$0.60 it costs today. Only 13% of sites hold the same position on both devices (Semrush, 50k keywords), so a desktop-only position is one most visitors never see. A **won** ladder's mobile check follows its monthly rhythm.
Wording rules: a call that failed stores `unavailable` and leaves every flag null — "check again", exactly as position -1, never "no AI Overview"; an AI Overview Google loads asynchronously comes back without its sources (loading them costs extra, which we do not buy), so "cites you" is then **unknown**, never "no"; the share of voice always travels with the sentence that says it is modelled, not measured clicks.
